items.title: News from the front, at every start
items.text: This window brings you the state of the Reborn servers, what is coming up and our videos. Press B or Esc to close it. The NEWS row on the main menu opens it again at any time.

items.title: Where to play
items.text: All Maps 1 to 4 and Air Superiority run in Europe, with one more server in US Central. The servers box here shows who is playing right now.

items.title: Join us on Discord
items.text: Find a squad, see when the servers fill up and tell us what you find in the playtest.

items.title: Found a bug?
items.text: Use Report an issue on the main menu, or open an issue on GitHub with what you did and what you saw.

items.title: Help build Reborn
items.text: The source is public on GitHub. Pull requests go to the in-dev branch and are tested there before a release.
